rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Hazards are potential sources of harm, danger, or adverse effects to people, property, the environment, or systems within or related to a specific piece of hardware.
Defines the level of automation a system possesses.
The destruction process is defined in this process.
An element of hardware and/or software utilized to carry out a particular function.
Information related to hardware dimension.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single or a collection of source files.
A license expression participating in a license set.
Provides an exploit assessment of a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: update
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications for a product update.
RequirementVerification class defines the base properties of a verification.
Provides a set of values to be used to describe the common types of SBOMs that tools may create.
The headquartersLocation defines the location of the organization's headquarters.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: numeric
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists only of numeric entries.
Identifies who or what created the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Legislation Identifier (ELI)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/content/help/eurlex-content/eli.html) is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) that uniquely identifies a legal resource, typically consisting of a document type, adoption year, and document number (e.g., `http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: falcon
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [FALCON](https://falcon-sign.info/falcon.pdf)
The result of applying a hash algorithm to an Element.
How the dataset was collected.
A product specification (product spec) is a detailed document that outlines the technical, functional, and design requirements of a product.
The version of the SPDX License List used in the license expression.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single file which can be independently distributed (configuration file, statically linked binary, Kubernetes deployment, etc.).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element (the instructions) of runs on each `to` Hardware (processing element), during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The third-highest level of risk posed by an AI system.
Use Process defines actions used by elements.
Defines the byte range in the original host file that the snippet information applies to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: compliance
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for compliance (i.e. export control, licensing).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: usesTool
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element uses each `to` Element as a tool, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Owner or Lead of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other units of energy measurement.
Specifies whether the License is listed as free by the Free Software Foundation (FSF).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: patch
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element contains a set of changes to update, fix, or improve another Element.
Designates elements as products where the impact of a vulnerability is being investigated.
Requirements can be categorized into various types based on their focus, purpose, and scope.
The element that has it's responsibility changed.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/SupplyChain/CreateProcess is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies an Extension characterization of some aspect of an Element.
Street address includes a street number, name and unit ID to identify a specific street.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: availableFrom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is available from the additional supplier described by each `to` Element.
Defines the version of a specific process.
This is the planned individual, business, or organization who currently manages goods, services, or assets.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: limitedSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and there is limited support available from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: megajoule
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Megajoule.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDistributionArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is distributed as an artifact in each `to` Element (e.g. an RPM or archive file).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_224
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 224, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to related security information of unspecified type.
Regulation represents a rule or directive maintained by an authority.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eolNotice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the End Of Sale (EOS) and/or End Of Life (EOL) information related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTestCase
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test case for the `from` Element (`from` hasTestCase `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory as defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.
This is the state of an affected Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element doesn't fit into any of the other categories.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe23
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration: Naming Specification Version 2.3](https://csrc.nist.gov/publications/detail/nistir/7695/final).
A verificationUUID is a universally unique identifier (UUID) assigned to a Verification item.
Reproduction is the biological process by which organisms generate new individuals of the same species.
Additional relevance information.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ocsp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Online Certificate Status Protocol, or OCSP, is a common scheme used to maintain the security of a server and other network resources.
Defines the line range in the original host file that the snippet information applies to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: configuration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is configuration data.
A distinct unit representing a constraint associated with an item's use in a system.
Links a vulnerability and elements representing products (in the VEX sense) where a fix has been applied and are no longer affected.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element optionally depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalComponent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an optional component of the `from` Element (`from` hasOptionalComponent `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: requirementUUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The UUID used by a requirements management or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a requirement item. UUID, or universally unique ID, is a standard term in requirements engineering.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where all elements apply.
This is the agent that performed the act of destroying the item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement that has verification (test, review, analysis etc.) details defined in the `to` RequirementVerification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidenceUUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The UUID used by a reporting management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify an evidence relationship item. UUID, or universally unique ID, is a standard term to refer to evidence items.
Reproduction is the biological process by which living organisms produce offspring.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conformsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element conforms to each `to` Assumption or Specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exploitCreatedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability has had an exploit created against it by each `to` Agent.
A collection of Elements that have a shared context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md6
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [MD6 hash function](https://people.csail.mit.edu/rivest/pubs/RABCx08.pdf)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability has been fixed by the `to` Agent(s).
Specifies the exploit catalog type.
Provides a numerical (0-10) representation of the severity of a vulnerability.
A physical location is a tangible, geographically identifiable place where objects, people, or assets exist or operate.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.
Title of the project.
A key used in a generic key-value pair.
The point in time when an element or an action ends, becomes no longer applicable, or becomes no longer valid.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isbn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Book Number (ISBN)](https://www.isbn-international.org/content/isbn-users-manual/29) is a unique numeric identifier for monographic publications standardized by [ISO 2108](https://www.iso.org/standard/65483.html). It consists of either 10 digits (for assignments prior to January 1, 2007) or 13 digits. A 13-digit ISBN is composed of five parts: a GS1 prefix, a registration group, a registrant, a publication element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9780198836063`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerabilityExploitabilityAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange (VEX) statement which provides information on whether a product is impacted by a specific vulnerability in an included package and, if affected, whether there are actions recommended to remediate. See also [NTIA VEX one-page summary](https://ntia.gov/files/ntia/publications/vex_one-page_summary.pdf).
Conveys information about how VEX status was determined.
Provides a reference number that can be used to understand how to parse and interpret an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Makes no assertion about the field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: staticAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a static analysis report for a package.
Preprocessing steps applied to the training data before the model training.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: md2
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: MD2 message-digest algorithm, as defined in [RFC 1319](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1319/).
A distinct article or unit within the domain.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasStaticLink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element statically links in each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
typeFromSource is a value used to define an item within the definitionSource.
An Organization representing the SPDX Project.
Anonymization methods used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tracedToDetail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: the `from` Requirement is refined and further elaborated by each `to` Requirement, which contains more detailed implementation information.
Records the storage of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: track
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability does not require action at this time. The organization would continue to track the vulnerability and reassess it if new information becomes available. CISA recommends remediating Track vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: query
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available, but not all at once, and can only be accessed through queries which return parts of the dataset.
HarvestAction represents the act of creating a product by directly extracting goods or materials from nature.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amendedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is amended by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/Core/ElementCollection is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: library
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software library.
Type of data in a dataset.
Product Part Number as defined by OEM.
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kev
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerability (KEV) catalog.
A key with an associated value.
A transport route refers to the planned path or network used to move people, goods, data, or resources from one location to another.
The measure of mass refers to the quantity of matter in an object or substance.
A short description of an Element.
A string in the license expression format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been trained on the `to` Element(s).

Provide the enumeration of possible decisions in the [Stakeholder-Specific Vulnerability Categorization (SSVC) decision tree](https://www.cisa.gov/stakeholder-specific-vulnerability-categorization-ssvc).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssociatedVulnerability
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to associate a `from` Artifact with each `to` Vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDependencyManifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has manifest files that contain dependency information in each `to` Element.
This process is used to determine the state of an affected Element.
The relative file name of a file to be excluded from the `PackageVerificationCode`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: urlScheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) Schemes](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/uri-schemes.xhtml). The scheme used in order to locate a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Artifact representing a serialization instance of SPDX data containing the definition of a particular Element.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/ExpandedLicensing/License is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Describes how an Agent provides support for an Artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audio
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is audio based, such as a collection of music from the 80s.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software manifest.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: productMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional product metadata such as reference within organization's product catalog.
The boundary parameters define the area or region needed to describe a boundary.
Potentially noisy elements of the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: device
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a chipset, processor, or electronic board.
Identifies the full text of a License, in SPDX templating format.
Specifies whether the License is listed as approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
Energy consumed during inference time by an AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pass
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a successful evaluation where the requirement or condition is clearly met.
Specifies a time when a vulnerability assessment was modified

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: delegatedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Agent is delegating an action to the Agent of the `to` Relationship (which shall be of type invokedBy), during a LifecycleScopeType (e.g. the `to` invokedBy Relationship is being done on behalf of `from`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: requirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element provides a requirement needed as input for another Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isni
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI)](https://isni.org/page/what-is-isni/) is a unique identifier used to distinguish the public identities of parties involved in the creation, production, and distribution of media content. Standardized by [ISO 27729](https://www.iso.org/standard/87177.html), it consists of 16 characters—15 digits plus a final check character—and is often represented as a URI, such as `https://isni.org/isni/000000012146438X`.
This is the individual, business, or organization who currently manages goods, services, or assets.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: socialMedia
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a social media channel for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kilowattHour
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Kilowatt-hour.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a test used to verify functionality on a software element.
Specifies the time an artifact was built.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A systematic examination of a system, process, or outcome to evaluate compliance of specific work products with a specific expectation with a specification, regulation or standard. Often involves judgement and a rationale of this judgement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any specification that does not fall under any of the other entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: platform
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents a runtime environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, a Wikipedia article (without images), or a transcript.
Records any relevant background information or additional comments about the origin of the package.
Provides information about the completeness of relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator to be governed by each `to` AnyLicenseInfo. If the `to` of an Artifact's `hasConcludedLicense` is not the same as the `to` of its `hasDeclaredLicense`, a written explanation should be provided in the comment field of the `hasConcludedLicense` relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasVariant
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a variant the `from` Element (`from` hasVariant `to`).
evidenceCategory refers to a category of documented or observable proof.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ownership
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Ownership refers to the legal right to control, manage, and benefit from an asset, resource, or responsibility. It establishes authority, accountability, and entitlements over something, whether it's property, a business, intellectual property, or responsibilities.
Test Process defines the testing process for an element.
Verification postcondition that are true immediately after a verification method has been performed
A collection of Elements, not necessarily with unifying context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inspection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thorough examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence. An inspection needs to have a defined set of acceptance criteria (e.g. a checklist), a documentation of roles involved in the inspection (e.g. to document the inspector's independence) and a clear documentation of when and how it was performed.
Describes a sensor used for collecting the data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: generates

An entity providing an assessment.
Defines the beginning of a range.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: structured
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is stored in tabular format or retrieved from a relational database.
Specifies the type of an external reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).
Quantity is the amount in the selected QUDT unit.
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.
VirtualHardwareModelType sets the VirtualHardware Model Type.
A test action is a specific action associated with a test.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Serial Number (ISSN)](https://www.issn.org/understanding-the-issn/what-is-an-issn/) is an eight-digit identifier for serial publications and other continuing resources standardized by [ISO 3297](https://www.iso.org/standard/84536.html). It consists of two groups of four digits separated by a hyphen, where the final character is a check digit that may be an "X". The hyphen is retained when the identifier is stored electronically to maintain the standard 9-character string format (e.g., `1464-3693`). The ISSN is media-specific; the same journal title may be assigned different identifiers for its physical and digital versions.
Products or commodities produced as a bulk unit are called bulk products. Commodities are often sold in bulk.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's design.
Specifies the SPDX License List version in which this ListedLicense or ListedLicenseException identifier was first added.

Property describing the start time of a build.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during development phase of an element.
Energy consumed when training the AI model that is being used in the AI system.
Describes if a given file is a directory or non-directory kind of file.
Refers to any object that stores content on a computer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.
Denote whether a CVE is present in an exploit catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Service profile specification.
References an Element on the right-hand side of a relationship.
Provides information about the primary purpose of the software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data type is not known.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: archive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an archived collection of one or more files (.tar, .zip, etc.).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: application
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gtin
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Trade Item Number (GTIN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin) is a number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a trade item (product or service).
The product lifecycle phase, the requirement is applicable for.
A license addition that is not listed on the SPDX Exceptions List.
Enumeration of the different kinds of SPDX file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: configures
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is a configuration applied to each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
An Individual Value for License when no assertion can be made about its actual value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: regulation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A mandatory legal specification issued by a governmental or regulatory authority. Compliance is enforceable by law.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPenTestReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a [penetration test](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penetration_test) report for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplyChain
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SupplyChain profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deviceDriver
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents software that controls hardware devices.
The valid state for DefinedStateProcess.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability was first reported to a project, vendor, or tracking database for formal identification by each `to` Agent.
This is how the currentState of an affected Element is found.
Specifies the type of the external identifier.
Location of a specific action.
Property that describes the URI of the build configuration source file.

An individual human being.

Information about different steps of the training process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables, packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.
Specifies the VEX justification type.
Records the biases that the dataset is known to encompass.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.
Identifier for specific product is called a serial number.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: custody
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Custody refers to the responsibility, control, and safekeeping of an asset, person, or legal entity. It involves both physical possession and legal authority over something or someone.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a bill of materials.
References the Element on the left-hand side of a relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a prerequisite on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

Availability of a dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM of intended, planned software project or product with included components (some of which may not yet exist) for a new software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data points in the dataset can be shared only with specific organizations and their clients on a need to know basis.

A state is an instance that describes what a system, component, subsystem, process, or project has achieved at any given time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inlineMitigationsAlreadyExist
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Built-in inline controls or mitigations prevent an adversary from leveraging the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isil
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Identifier for Libraries and Related Organizations (ISIL)](https://slks.dk/english/work-areas/libraries-and-literature/library-standards/isil/) is a unique alphanumeric code for identifying libraries, archives, museums, and related organizations standardized by [ISO 15511](https://www.iso.org/standard/77849.html). It consists of a prefix—which may be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or a non-country code assigned by the ISIL Registration Authority—followed by a unit identifier, totaling up to 16 characters (e.g., `FI-Sipoo-Sö` or `ZDB-1-SBD`). Valid symbols include any alphanumeric character, solidus (`/`), hyphen-minus (`-`), or colon.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serializedInArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` SpdxDocument can be found in a serialized form in each `to` Artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)).
